messages:
sam_support: Hi team — trial customer is hitting 429s during a live demo. They need a short burst increase for ~2 hours. Account: acct_9b2f, region: us-west-2. Observed window: ~100 req/s -> 429s after a few mins. Can we do a temporary bridge?

liz_sales: @sam_support can you paste their current plan tier and the demo timing? we can do a sales-assisted uplift for short demos but need billing opt-in or PO. :thinking_face:

sam_support: They are on free-tier (no billing attached). Demo is today 14:00 PST for ~90 mins. Customer says investors will join. They asked for 5x throughput.

kai_sre: quick questions — do we see X-RateLimit headers on responses? need a sample request id from the 429s (x-request-id or we can use the trace id). also share a request sample (endpoint + body) so we can check prefix caching/batching impact.

mike_eng: also confirm auth flow — if token is rotated mid-demo we sometimes see 401->retry->throttle patterns. ask them to include the exact Authorization header (masked) and a curl if possible.

sam_support: here's the curl they sent (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/complete \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"open-compat-1","input":"run demo chat","max_tokens":512}'
```
They also included this response snippet: `HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests` and header `Retry-After: 30` and no X-RateLimit-* headers present. request id header: `x-request-id: r-0a4c`

redwood-bot: [rate-limit] acct_9b2f triggered rate_limit_exceeded at 2026-03-15T21:05:12Z (count=720 in 60s)

kai_sre: got it. absence of X-RateLimit-* means the request probably hit our upstream limiter before our enhanced headers were set. I'll pull logs for r-0a4c and check if this is per-account throttling or per-IP.

liz_sales: since they're unauth'd to billing we can't add seats instantly via billing UI. two quick options: 1) create a short promo code that maps to a trial paid seat (ops handles account side), or 2) temporary manual quota bump from infra (SRE) for a specified window. which is faster?

sam_support: infra bump would be fastest if SRE can approve — customer needs it in 45 minutes.

kai_sre: we can do a temporary quota increase up to 4x for up to 2 hours from infra side without full sales contract, but we need an approval note in the ticket and an expected QPS number. send me expected sustained qps and peak. also confirm if they can route traffic from fixed IPs so we can whitelist.

sam_support: quoted numbers from customer: sustained 120 req/s, peak 250 req/s. they cannot guarantee fixed IPs (demo from laptop pool).

mike_eng: notes — model open-compat-1 looks CPU-heavy at max_tokens=512. suggest lowering max_tokens or using streaming to reduce concurrent token work. Also suggest using smaller batch sizes and enabling prefix cache if they can reuse prompts.

liz_sales: i'll prepare a short one-off promo approach if SRE needs extra time. but if infra can do the bump and SRE approves, we should document approval and TTL in the support ticket. customer contact: demo_lead@custco.com (sam will send origin-of-request). :+1:

kai_sre: proceeding with logs now. if we can confirm it's per-account cap, i'll push a temporary 3x burst for 2 hours. final ask: add the exact timeframe (start/end in UTC) and confirm no concurrent load tests scheduled.

sam_support: start 2026-03-15T21:30:00Z end 2026-03-15T23:30:00Z. no load tests. i've asked customer to reduce max_tokens to 256 as per engineering suggestion. sending contact details now.

mike_eng: thanks. also if they continue to hit limits after the bump, we should capture a sample full HTTP/2 trace and the client retry logic — exponential backoff might be misconfigured.

kai_sre: approved temporary bump -> 3x sustained for 2 hours starting at 2026-03-15T21:30:00Z. document set in ticket SPT-3421. I'll monitor and will rollback early if we see abuse.

sam_support: deployed bump and notified customer. will monitor metrics and update ticket with final outcome after demo. :rocket:

liz_sales: thanks team — i'll follow up with billing ops about conversion path. sam, please paste a short post-demo summary (counts, any errors) so sales can decide conversion nudges.

sam_support: will do.

redwood-bot: [notice] temporary_quota_change applied to acct_9b2f by kai_sre (3x, ttl=2h)

sam_support: demo finished — customer reports smooth run, ~1.8M tokens consumed across session, no additional 429s after bump. will close ticket after final billing note.

kai_sre: thanks, closing monitoring window. please attach billing opt-in link to ticket for sales follow-up.

liz_sales: great outcome. i'll send an intro to our AE for follow-up on dedicated capacity options. :tada:
